messages:
emma-partnerships: Quick thread — want to align on a reproducible playbook for Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB integrations. Goal: consistent launch cadence for connectors + marketplace listing + joint announcement.
vikram-gTM: love it. do we want a single playbook or separate flavors per partner? snowflake vs databricks have different marketplace rules.
emma-partnerships: separate templates but shared checklist. one canonical checklist + partner-specific annex. less duplication. :white_check_mark:
luke-platform: tech constraints to call out: Snowflake uses external functions/Snowpark patterns; Databricks prefers init notebooks + Unity Catalog perms. vector DBs vary widely (hosted vs self-hosted) — need adapter tests.
sara-product: can we standardize an E2E demo pattern? small dataset, notebook + API sample + perf numbers (p95 latency, qps) and simple validation suite.
emma-partnerships: yep. propose sections: 1) partner prerequisites 2) tech integration steps 3) security/compliance 4) marketplace listing fields 5) launch timeline & PR cadence 6) post-launch metrics
vikram-gTM: for marketplace listing fields we'll need SKU, pricing guidance, support contact, 2-sentence product blurb, architecture diagram, and approved logos. Also legal needs an approved co-marketing addendum.
luke-platform: tech integration steps (rough):
```
1) repo scaffold: connectors/<partner> with README and samples
2) auth patterns: service account + role/permission docs
3) integration tests: smoke, perf (50-500 seq), regression prompts
4) deployment recipe: hosted vs dedicated vs private notes
```
emma-partnerships: nice. add a section for quantization/throughput notes for our runtime when calling vector DBs (batched search -> rerank).
sara-product: marketing asks: embargo window (2 weeks), blog + joint webinar + customer quote if possible. Coordinate timelines: marketplace listing -> soft launch -> joint announcement.
emma-partnerships: propose tentative timeline:
- week 0: integration E2E complete internally
- week 1: partner review + security checklist
- week 2: marketplace listing published (soft)
- week 3: joint PR & webinar (embargo lifts)
(can compress if partner prefers)
vikram-gTM: assign owners: marketplace listing = vikram, tech docs + sample notebooks = luke, co-marketing + PR = emma, product QA + validation = sara. ok? :+1:
luke-platform: ok. i'll create the connector scaffold and a CI job for integration tests. ETA: 4 business days.
ops-bot: Reminder: partnership-kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC — invites sent.
emma-partnerships: thanks — agenda for the kickoff: review checklist, partner-specific gaps, legal/compliance must-haves, demo run of notebook.
sara-product: small note on data residency: Snowflake customers in EU require region-specific endpoints; add a checkbox under security.
emma-partnerships: added. action items summarized: [vikram -> marketplace listing draft by Fri], [luke -> connector repo + CI by Thu], [sara -> validation suite + demo dataset by Fri], [emma -> draft co-marketing brief & PR timeline by Mon]. if no objections i'll drop these in Asana.
vikram-gTM: no objections. tagging legal to loop in next: @legal (will ping after kickoff).
luke-platform: one more tech ask — do we include a minimal vector adapter interface in our SDK or ship partner-specific libs? my vote: minimal adapter spec + example for pinecone/weaviate.
emma-partnerships: agree. keep SDK lightweight + add partner adapters in examples repo.
ops-bot: Thread archived after 2 days of inactivity.
